rules.name: ouat178-wp-vs-legacy-0611
rules.sql: SELECT security_id, settle_price, settle_delta_1, settle_delta_2, settle_vega_1, settle_theta FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND value_date = DATE '2026-11-06' AND security_id IN ('CM WP 20261215.K27 CM WP 20261215.K27 P 125 CS', 'CM WP H27.H27 CM WP H27.H27 P 106 CS', 'CM WP Z26.Z26 CM WP H27.H27 P 77 CS')

SELECT s.security_id, s.created_by, s.created_timestamp, s.updated_by, s.updated_timestamp FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table s WHERE s.tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND s.business_unit = 'CFS' AND s.value_date = DATE '2026-11-06' AND s.security_id LIKE 'CM WP %' AND NOT (coalesce(s.created_by, '') = 'migration' AND coalesce(s.updated_by, 'migration') = 'migration' AND s.created_timestamp = TIMESTAMP '2026-11-07 11:22:08')

SELECT s.security_id, s.created_by, s.created_timestamp, s.updated_by, s.updated_timestamp, (SELECT max(m.created_timestamp) FROM opera.correl_product_mapping m WHERE m.tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND m.business_unit = 'CFS') AS mapping_loaded, now() AS db_now FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table s WHERE s.tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND s.business_unit = 'CFS' AND s.value_date = DATE '2026-11-06' AND s.security_id LIKE 'CM WP %' ORDER BY s.security_id

SELECT value_date, count(*) AS rows_written, min(greatest(created_timestamp, coalesce(updated_timestamp, created_timestamp))) AS first_write, max(greatest(created_timestamp, coalesce(updated_timestamp, created_timestamp))) AS last_write, count(*) FILTER (WHERE security_id LIKE 'CM WP %') AS wp_rows FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND greatest(created_timestamp, coalesce(updated_timestamp, created_timestamp)) > now() - interval '3 days' GROUP BY value_date ORDER BY last_write DESC
SELECT * FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND upper(business_unit) = 'CFS'

SELECT business_unit, product_code, primary_code, secondary_code, primary_multiplier, secondary_multiplier FROM opera.correl_product_mapping WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' ORDER BY 1, 2
